# Travel Curious

> > Travel Curious offers curated private guided tours across Europe and North America, specializing in cultural heritage, archaeological sites, and authentic local experiences.

Travel Curious connects travelers with expert local guides for personalized walking tours, food experiences, and day trips in historic cities like Rome, Paris, Berlin, and Venice. The platform emphasizes UNESCO World Heritage sites, ancient history, and immersive cultural exploration.

## Key Topics

- Private walking tours
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Ancient Rome and archaeological sites
- Pompeii and Herculaneum
- Berlin Wall and Holocaust Memorial
- Local food experiences
- Cultural heritage tours
- Expert local guides
- First-time visitor experiences
- European city landmarks
- Full-day and half-day tours
- History and archaeology
- Market Square experiences
- Temple of the Augustali
- House of Neptune and Amphitrite

- [Eat Like a Roman: Private Half-Day Food Tour by Golf Cart](https://travelcurious.com/italy/rome/tours/eat-like-a-roman-private-half-day-food-tour-by-golf-cart-T1LMMR): Private Rome food tour by golf cart with tastings & local cuisine
- [Welcome to Naples: Private 2-hour Highlights Walking Tour](https://travelcurious.com/italy/naples/tours/welcome-to-naples-private-2-hour-highlights-walking-tour-TRMB9A): 2-hour private tour of Naples UNESCO historic center highlights
